publication: Prepared locally; no GitHub release published.

validation.upgrade: adb install -r over published version 6 succeeded; Calgary and saved station osm-node-266330515 remained. Atomic snapshot migration verified. Checked on the release build before the final dropdown-height and navigation-inset fixes, which change no stored data.
release_smoke: Map and remote brand logos rendered
City lookup returned Lethbridge, AB with keyboard and results visible at 360dp/font 1.3
Map marker opened station detail with Also at this spot; tapping Shell switched station detail
Final release build at 360dp/font 1.3: area dropdown opens below its chip and scrolls; collapsed sheet paints no station row through the navigation inset

performance.method: One run per variant, same API 35 software-rendered emulator at 1080x2400/density 420. Expanded list: six upward and six downward 350 ms swipes with 450 ms pauses; settings: five open/Back cycles with 700 ms pauses. Debug used OPENFUEL_COMPACT_APK=false. Release used R8 and resource shrinking. gfxinfo counters cover each full phase; UI-thread samples are the retained window framestats (SyncQueued minus HandleInputStart).
performance.limit: Single software-emulator comparison, not a hardware frame-rate claim. The planned threefold frame-count target was not observed; rendered frames remained janky in both variants. Release list UI-thread samples improved; settings retained occasional long frames.

deferred: C14 baseline profiles remain deferred as specified in the original package instructions.
Physical-device gesture feel and hardware frame timing were not measured.
